r0.why: Only natural satellite, elliptical orbit averaging 378,000 km, 29.5-day synodic month per [1,2,3].

r1.why: Gravity stronger on facing sides, tides, tidal locking syncs day to month, libration shows 59% per [4,5,6,20].

r2.why: Planetary-mass, 1.2% mass, 3,474 km, larger than dwarf planets, fifth-largest moon, largest relative to planet, 1/6 g, differentiated per [7-11].

r3.why: Regolith from impacts, rayed craters, volcanism until 1.2 Gyr on near side forming maria per [12-14].

r4.why: Giant impact of Mars-sized body, 4.35 Gyr from magma-ocean crystallization dating per [15,16].

r5.why: Phases, lunar eclipse, apparent size equals Sun's for total eclipse, brightest due to size, asphalt-like albedo per [17-19].

r6.why: Luna 1/2 1959, Luna 9/10 1966, Apollo 8 and 11 dates, six missions twelve people by 1972, Artemis II 2026 per [22-26].

r7.why: Capital M, IAU convention, Old English mona from PIE 'month', Latin luna and lunar, selene and seleno-/selenography per cited.
